name: append written once when another file fails
compound assignment evaluates its subscript once
script: awk 'BEGIN { i=1; a[i++] += 2; print i, a[1], a[2] }'

name: increment evaluates its subscript once
script: awk 'BEGIN { i=1; a[i++]++; ++a[i++]; print i, a[1], a[2], a[3] }'

name: assignment evaluates its target before its value
script: awk 'BEGIN { i=1; a[i++] = i; print i, a[1], a[2] }'

name: field compound assignment evaluates its index once
script: echo 'a b c' | awk '{ i=1; $(i++) += 5; print i, $0 }'

name: sub evaluates its target once
script: awk 'BEGIN { i=1; s[1]="aaa"; n=sub(/a/, "x", s[i++]); print n, i, s[1], s[2] }'

name: sub takes the longest alternative
script: awk 'BEGIN { s="aa"; sub(/a|aa/, "x", s); print s }'

name: match takes the longest at the leftmost start
script: awk 'BEGIN { print match("aa", /a|aa/), RSTART, RLENGTH; print match("xabcd", /b|abc/), RSTART, RLENGTH }'

name: longest through groups
script: awk 'BEGIN { print match("xab", /x(a|ab)/), RLENGTH; print match("abcd", /(a|ab)(c|bcd)/), RLENGTH }'

name: longest keeps anchors on the whole string
script: awk 'BEGIN { print match("ab", /a|ab$/), RLENGTH; print match("abc", /a|ab$/), RLENGTH; s="baa"; print gsub(/^b|^ba|a/, "x", s), s }'

name: gsub takes the longest alternative each time
script: awk 'BEGIN { s="abab"; print gsub(/a|ab/, "[&]", s), s; t="aa"; print gsub(/x*|a/, "-", t), t; u="abc"; print gsub(/(a|ab)*/, "<&>", u), u }'

name: split and FS take the longest separator
script: echo 1ab2a3 | awk -F'a|ab' '{ n = split($0, p, /a|ab/); print NF, $2, $3, n, p[2] }'

name: RS regex groups are not records
ARGV deleted or emptied in BEGIN
script: awk 'BEGIN { delete ARGV[1] } { print FILENAME, $0 }' a.txt b.txt; awk 'BEGIN { ARGV[2]="" } { print FILENAME, $0 }' a.txt b.txt

name: every ARGV deleted reads stdin
script: echo S | awk 'BEGIN { delete ARGV[1] } { print "[" FILENAME "]", $0 }' a.txt

name: ARGV grown and ARGC cut in BEGIN
script: awk 'BEGIN { ARGV[ARGC++]="b.txt" } { print FILENAME, $0 }' a.txt; awk 'BEGIN { ARGC=2 } { print FILENAME, $0 }' a.txt b.txt

name: ARGV changed while reading
script: awk 'NR==1 { ARGV[2]="a.txt" } { print FILENAME, $0 }' a.txt b.txt
